rain: Rain dey fall for Marlow Street, the kind rain wey dey swallow sound of footsteps.
call: Small after midnight, somebody call say one man dey lie down for the alley wey dey behind the bakery.
tape: Detective Nia stand behind the yellow tape, dey watch as red and blue light dey pulse inside the narrow passage like say e dey breathe.
bello: Officer Bello stand for her side, young boy, rain don soak am finish, e dey try make e no look like say fear dey catch am.
nobody: “Nobody hear anything,” na wetin e talk. “No shout, no motor. Nothing.”
lift: Nia raise the tape come waka enter the alley.
puddles: The water wey gather for ground dey shine anytime the police light turn.
body: Dem don find one man for the far end, beside the old brick wall.
hand: Im right hand close tight for one something.
button: Nia open im finger dem softly. Inside am na one brass button.
not-his: She check im coat. All im button complete. This one na another person own.
witness: No weapon. No wallet. Na only one witness dey: one girl wey swear say she no see anything.
witness.ask: Why the girl talk say she no see anything?
step: She sidon for the bakery step under one big umbrella, hold one cup of tea wey she never touch.
ama: Her name na Ama. She go be like nineteen years.
crouch: Nia bend down for her side. “You see anything tonight?”
asleep: “Nothing,” Ama talk, she no even look up. “I dey sleep.”
window: But the window wey dey on top the bakery, straight over the alley, im light still dey on.
wait: Nia no call am liar. She just talk say, “I go dey near.”
streetlight: But the streetlight above the narrow passage don dey blink all night.
broken: “That lamp don spoil since many years,” Bello talk. “Nobody dey ever fix am.”
not-random: Nia notice say the light no dey just blink anyhow.
pattern: E go go off for three seconds, then flash two times.
again: Three seconds of dark. Two flash. Then dark again.
message: Again and again, like say person dey send message.
someone: Lamp no dey count. Na somebody wey dey near dey make am do like that.
someone.ask: Who dey make the lamp dey blink?
key: She follow the way the light dey blink reach the pole, come find one small brass key wey dem use tape hold under am.
wall: Nia turn slowly. For the end of the alley, near the man, the old brick wall stand there.
patch: Most of the bricks don black and old. But one part fresh pass, e new, and e get shape like door.
patch.ask: Why some bricks new pass the others?
door: The key fit the lock of one door wey dem don use brick block for twenty years.
door.ask: Who use brick block the door?
pull: Dem pull the loose bricks comot one by one, inside the rain.
groan: The key turn with one rusty sound, and one small wooden door open.
cupboard: Behind the bricks, one cupboard dey, and na only one photograph dey inside am.
photo: For the photograph, the girl wey be witness still small well-well, dey stand beside the man wey don missing.
writing: For the back, with ink wey don fade: “Marlow Street. The night wey light go off.”
writing.ask: Wetin happen the night wey light go off?
blackout: Twenty years ago, the whole street no get light until morning.
vanished: And that same night, one man from Marlow Street disappear. Dem no ever find am.
same-face: Nia look the photo, then look the man wey dey near the wall. Na the same face, twenty years older.
came-back: E no die that night. E run comot. And tonight, e come back.
buttons: For the photo, another man stand half for outside the picture. Im coat get one line of brass buttons.
face-cut: Dem don tear im face comot from the picture.
wire: Then Nia look up. One thin wire run from the lamp post, follow the wall, reach Ama window wey light dey.
switch: Somebody for up there don dey talk to her all night, with light.
daughter: For the photo, the small girl hold im hand the way pikin wey be im daughter dey hold am.
truth: No be say the girl no see anything. She see everything, and she don dey wait make somebody ask the right question.
rain-softer: The rain come calm. The lamp stop to blink, e just dey shine.
walk-back: Nia waka back pass the water for ground reach the bakery step.
looked-up: Ama drop her cold tea and, for the first time that night, she look up face am.
right-question: And Nia sabi exactly wetin she go ask.
